Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

	We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Procurement Specialist to join our civil construction team. In this role, you will lead the sourcing, negotiation, and acquisition of construction materials, equipment, and subcontractor services.
	You will ensure all project procurement is cost-effective, high-quality, and delivered on schedule to keep our civil engineering projects running smoothly.


Key Responsibilities


	Sourcing & Vendor Management: Identify, evaluate, and onboard reliable suppliers and subcontractors for civil construction materials (e.g., cement, steel, aggregates, asphalt, piping) and heavy machinery/plant hire.
	Cost Estimation & BOQ Review: Analyze Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and technical drawings to estimate material quantities, prepare cost comparisons, and ensure alignment with project budgets.
	Negotiation & Contract Management: Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules with suppliers and subcontractors to secure the best commercial terms without compromising quality or safety.
	Purchase Order (PO) Processing: Prepare, issue, and track purchase orders, ensuring all documentation is accurate and compliant with company policies.
	Logistics & Delivery Coordination: Coordinate with site managers, logistics teams, and suppliers to schedule timely deliveries to various construction sites, minimizing project downtime.
	Market Analysis: Monitor market trends, price fluctuations of construction materials, and supply chain risks to proactively develop cost-saving sourcing strategies.
	Quality Assurance: Collaborate with project engineers to ensure all procured materials meet required technical specifications, industry standards, and regulatory compliance.


Requirements and Qualifications


	Education: Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Purchasing and Supply Chain Management, Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Building Technology, or a related field.
	Experience: Minimum of 5 - 10 years of proven experience as a Procurement Specialist or Buyer specifically within the civil construction or civil engineering industry.
	Added Advantage: A background or formal training in Quantity Surveying (QS) is highly desirable and will be given strong preference.
	Technical Skills: Strong ability to read construction drawings, interpret Bills of Quantities (BOQ), and use procurement or ERP software.
	Key Competencies: Exceptional negotiation, contract management, analytical, and communication skills.
	Attributes: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of working under pressure to meet tight project deadlines across multiple construction sites.

N350,000 - N500,000 per month.

Job Position: Executive Housekeeper

Job Location: Abia

Main Function


	The Executive Housekeeper is responsible for the strategic leadership, planning, organization, and overall management of the Housekeeping Department to ensure the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, maintenance, comfort, aesthetics, and guest satisfaction throughout the hotel.
	The role oversees guest rooms, suites, public areas, back-of-house areas, laundry operations, linen and uniform management, floral arrangements, housekeeping stores, and housekeeping administration, ensuring that all facilities consistently meet the standards of a superior luxury hotel.
	The Executive Housekeeper develops departmental strategies, policies, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), manages budgets and resources, leads and develops the housekeeping team, and ensures operational efficiency, cost control, inventory management, quality assurance, health and safety compliance, and sustainability initiatives.
	The role collaborates closely with Front Office, Engineering, Food &amp; Beverage, Security, Procurement, Human Resources, and other departments to deliver exceptional guest experiences while maximizing operational performance and profitability.


Role Responsibilities
Departmental Leadership &amp; Housekeeping Operations:


	Provide strategic leadership and direction for all housekeeping operations across the hotel.
	Plan, organize, supervise, and evaluate the daily activities of the Housekeeping Department.
	Ensure guest rooms, suites, corridors, public areas, offices, restaurants, banquet facilities, spa, gym, meeting rooms, staff areas, and back-of-house facilities are maintained to impeccable luxury standards.
	Develop daily operational plans and allocate manpower effectively.
	Conduct regular inspections of all housekeeping areas to ensure compliance with quality standards.
	Ensure rooms are cleaned, inspected, and released for occupancy within established timelines.
	Oversee deep cleaning programmes, spring cleaning schedules, and preventive housekeeping initiatives.


Guest Room &amp; Public Area Management:


	Ensure all guest rooms and public areas consistently meet the hotel&#39;s cleanliness, presentation, and luxury standards.
	Monitor room readiness in collaboration with the Front Office Department.
	Conduct random inspections of occupied, vacant, VIP, and newly cleaned rooms.
	Ensure public areas remain clean, welcoming, and aesthetically appealing throughout the day.
	Coordinate room preparation for VIPs, dignitaries, long-stay guests, and special occasions.
	Ensure guest amenities are properly stocked and presented. Laundry, Linen &amp; Uniform Management
	Oversee all hotel laundry operations, including guest laundry, staff uniforms, hotel linen, towels, banquet linen, spa linen, and specialty fabrics.
	Ensure timely processing and distribution of clean linen and uniforms.
	Maintain appropriate par stock levels for all linen categories.
	Monitor linen circulation and minimize losses through effective inventory management.
	Approve linen replacement schedules and procurement requirements.
	Ensure laundry operations comply with quality, hygiene, and fabric care standards.
	Monitor dry-cleaning services and outsourced laundry vendors where applicable. Inventory &amp; Asset Management
	Maintain accurate inventories of linen, uniforms, housekeeping equipment, cleaning chemicals, guest supplies, and consumables.
	Conduct regular inventory counts and stock audits.
	Monitor usage patterns and implement measures to reduce wastage and losses.
	Ensure housekeeping stores are properly organized and secured.
	Verify inventory records and stock movements.
	Coordinate procurement requests for housekeeping supplies and equipment.
	Safeguard all housekeeping assets and equipment.


Budgeting &amp; Cost Control:


	Prepare and manage the annual housekeeping operating and capital budgets.
	Monitor departmental expenditure against approved budgets.
	Control labour costs through effective manpower planning and scheduling.
	Monitor consumption of cleaning chemicals, guest amenities, linen, uniforms, and operational supplies.
	Implement cost-saving initiatives without compromising service quality.
	Review supplier pricing and recommend cost-effective purchasing solutions.
	Analyze departmental financial performance and recommend corrective actions where necessary.


Quality Assurance &amp; Service Excellence:


	Develop and maintain housekeeping quality standards and inspection programmes.
	Conduct routine quality audits and room inspections.
	Ensure all housekeeping activities comply with luxury hospitality standards.
	Monitor guest feedback relating to cleanliness and housekeeping services.
	Investigate service failures and implement corrective actions.
	Promote continuous improvement in housekeeping service delivery.
	Benchmark housekeeping performance against international best practices.


Team Leadership &amp; Human Resource Management:


	Recruit, train, coach, mentor, and supervise housekeeping employees.
	Prepare departmental duty rosters and manpower schedules.
	Conduct performance appraisals and identify training needs.
	Ensure employees comply with grooming, attendance, and behavioural standards.
	Promote teamwork, discipline, accountability, and employee engagement.
	Identify and develop future housekeeping leaders through succession planning.
	Conduct regular departmental meetings and performance reviews.


Health, Safety &amp; Hygiene:


	Ensure strict compliance with hotel hygiene, sanitation, and infection prevention standards.
	Monitor proper handling, storage, and use of cleaning chemicals.
	Ensure housekeeping staff use Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) appropriately.
	Maintain safe working environments throughout housekeeping operations.
	Coordinate pest control programmes with approved contractors.
	Ensure compliance with fire safety, occupational health, and environmental regulations.
	Investigate workplace accidents and implement preventive measures. Coordination with Other Departments
	Collaborate with Front Office to ensure room availability and occupancy targets are achieved.
	Coordinate with Engineering regarding preventive maintenance, repairs, and refurbishment projects.
	Liaise with Food &amp; Beverage for banquet linen requirements and event support.
	Work with Procurement to ensure timely availability of housekeeping supplies.
	Coordinate with Human Resources on recruitment, training, and employee welfare matters.
	Support Security in managing lost-and-found procedures and guest property protection.


Environmental Sustainability:


	Promote environmentally responsible housekeeping practices.
	Implement programmes to reduce water, electricity, and chemical consumption.
	Encourage waste reduction, recycling, and responsible disposal of cleaning materials.
	Promote environmentally friendly cleaning products where appropriate.
	Support the hotel&#39;s sustainability and corporate social responsibility initiatives.


Reporting &amp; Administration:


	Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, and annual housekeeping operational reports.
	Monitor departmental Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
	Maintain accurate housekeeping records, inspection reports, inventory reports, maintenance logs, and staffing records.
	Prepare housekeeping budgets, forecasts, and business plans.
	Submit departmental performance reports to Executive Management.
	Maintain proper documentation for audits and compliance reviews. Compliance &amp; Continuous Improvement
	Ensure compliance with hotel policies, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), statutory regulations, and luxury hospitality standards.
	Support internal and external audits.
	Review and update housekeeping SOPs regularly.
	Identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency.
	Promote innovation, quality improvement, and service excellence throughout the department.


Qualifications and Requirements
Education and Certifications:


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or HND in Hospitality Management or related field.
	Professional housekeeping certification is an advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 5 years of housekeeping experience, with at least 2 years in a managerial role in a luxury or upscale hotel.


Skills:
Technical Skills:


	Housekeeping SOPs and standards.
	Inventory and budget management.
	PMS room status coordination.
	Chemical and equipment safety.


Soft Skills:


	Attention to detail.
	Leadership and staff development.
	Organization.
	Discipline and consistency.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letters to: recruitment@domeoresources.org using &quot;Housekeeper _Aba&quot; as the subject of the email.
